note: Planted vulnerabilities. Match by file + issue; line +-3 counts. Decoys must NOT be reported.

vulns.title: mint() has no access control: anyone mints unlimited tokens
withdraw() makes an external call to msg.sender before updating shares (reentrancy, drain)
getPrice() uses single-pool spot reserves; Vault.borrow() trusts it, so a flash loan inflates collateral and drains the vault (cross-contract)
upgradeTo() has no access check: anyone swaps the implementation
Proxy implementation sits in slot 0, same slot as Vault.owner: initialize() via delegatecall overwrites the implementation (storage collision, cross-contract)
initialize() has no initializer guard: anyone can call it again and take ownership
Shares priced from token.balanceOf(this): first-depositor inflation / donation attack
borrow() mixes 8-decimal ETH/USD feed with 18-decimal amounts (decimals mismatch)
transferFrom() subtracts balance in unchecked block: underflow mints balance
Deployer private key hardcoded in the deploy script
withdraw() rounds assets up, in the withdrawer's favour (drains dust, breaks share price)
distributeRewards() loops an unbounded depositors array (gas DoS)
deposit() ignores the bool returned by transferFrom (shares minted when transfer returns false)
getEthUsd() ignores updatedAt/answer sign: stale or negative feed accepted
setFee() has no upper bound on feeBps
Implementation Vault deployed but never initialized: anyone can claim it
Floating pragma ^0.8.0 while other contracts pin 0.8.20

decoys.why: claimRewards zeroes balance before transfer (CEI), nonReentrant, checks transfer return
burn checks balance and uses checked arithmetic
